sections.title: Biotech Regulatory Submission Automation
sections.description: For Biogen, Moderna, Vertex Pharmaceuticals, and Boston's world-class biotech regulatory community.

blocks.heading: IND and NDA module automation
paragraphs: AI for assembling the Clinical Study Reports, Integrated Summaries of Safety, and other Common Technical Document (CTD) modules that FDA submissions require — automating the data extraction, formatting, and cross-referencing from clinical databases, laboratory data systems, and analysis outputs for the IND and NDA submissions that Boston's biotech companies file at extraordinary frequency.

blocks.heading: Regulatory correspondence tracking
paragraphs: AI for managing the correspondence with FDA reviewers — organizing FDA information requests, cross-referencing responses to prior requests, and ensuring complete responses to FDA questions within 21 CFR-required response windows.

blocks.heading: Post-market safety reporting automation
paragraphs: AI for the MedWatch 3500A adverse event reports and periodic safety update reports that marketed Boston biotech products must submit — extracting adverse event data from pharmacovigilance databases and formatting 21 CFR Part 314 compliant safety reports.

sections.title: Clinical Documentation and Revenue Cycle Automation
sections.description: For Mass General Brigham, Dana-Farber, and Boston's academic medical centers.

blocks.heading: Ambient clinical documentation
paragraphs: AI for the ambient documentation programs that Boston's large academic medical centers have been deploying — converting physician-patient encounter audio (with physician consent) to structured SOAP notes in the physician's documented style, integrated with Epic EHR for seamless physician review and sign-off.

blocks.heading: Massachusetts payer prior authorization automation
paragraphs: AI assembling and submitting prior authorization for Massachusetts's commercial payers (BCBS Massachusetts, Tufts Health Plan, Harvard Pilgrim Health Care) and Massachusetts Medicaid (MassHealth) for Mass General Brigham's large multi-specialty patient population.

blocks.heading: Clinical trial enrollment documentation
paragraphs: AI for the research coordinator documentation burden in clinical trial enrollment — automating eligibility screening documentation, consent form processing, and the regulatory binder organization for the enormous clinical trial portfolios at Boston's academic medical centers.

sections.title: Investment Research Automation
sections.description: For Fidelity Investments, Wellington Management, and Boston's large investment management community.

blocks.heading: Earnings call transcript processing
paragraphs: AI for the rapid processing of earnings call transcripts for the large equity research teams at Fidelity and Wellington — automating key metrics extraction, management guidance summarization, and comparison to prior quarter guidance for the thousands of earnings calls that Boston's large investment research organizations process each quarter.

blocks.heading: SEC filing extraction and summarization
paragraphs: AI for the systematic processing of 10-K, 10-Q, and proxy statements for the companies in Fidelity's and Wellington's research coverage universes — automating the extraction of critical financial metrics, management discussion summaries, and risk factor changes for analyst review.

sections.title: Life Sciences Legal Automation
sections.description: For Goodwin Procter, WilmerHale, and Boston's large life sciences and technology law firms.

blocks.heading: FDA regulatory history research automation
paragraphs: AI for the regulatory history research that life sciences law firms conduct for their FDA advisory and litigation clients — automating the extraction of precedent regulatory decisions, FDA Warning Letter history, and regulatory enforcement actions from FDA databases.

blocks.heading: Patent and IP document automation
paragraphs: AI for the large patent prosecution and IP analytics practices at Boston's life sciences law firms — automating patent family mapping, claim chart generation, and prior art search organization for the biotech and pharmaceutical patent prosecution that is Boston's most commercially significant legal work.

sections.title: Boston automation technical context
sections.description: Key technical and compliance considerations for Boston AI automation deployments.

blocks.heading: 21 CFR Part 11 for all biotech automation
paragraphs: FDA's electronic records and signatures rule applies to automation that generates or modifies records subject to FDA inspection — ClickMasters designs all Boston biotech automation with 21 CFR Part 11 compliance as a non-negotiable baseline.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted for biotech IP
paragraphs: Boston biotech regulatory documents — IND modules, clinical study reports, proprietary compound data — cannot be processed by external cloud AI services. ClickMasters deploys biotech document automation on client corporate infrastructure.

blocks.heading: Massachusetts health law for clinical automation
paragraphs: Massachusetts health information privacy requirements, including specific mental health and substance use disorder protections, apply to Boston healthcare automation. ClickMasters designs Boston clinical automation with Massachusetts privacy requirements alongside HIPAA.
